title: Rating Manual: Towing and Labor Coverage Premium Proration and Rounding
content:
**Rule.** Towing premium under **Towing and Labor Coverage** is booked only while the coverage is scheduled, active, removed or terminated. The amount of each charge or return is the vehicle's full-term towing premium multiplied by the premium days and divided by the owner term days, rounded to the nearest cent, half up. Premium is charged on the vehicle towing premium for the owner term, prorated from the effective date. The same rule applies on every Cardinal Point Towing and Labor package ($50 through $200).

## Quantities in the rule

- **Full-term towing premium:** the vehicle's towing premium for the whole owner term.
- **Premium days:** the number of days the charge or the return covers, prorated from the effective date of that entry.
- **Owner term days:** the number of days in the owner term.
- **Rounding:** the result of the multiplication and division is rounded once, to the nearest cent, with a half cent rounded up.

## Status of the coverage

The coverage status is read from the company's record of that towing coverage, before the entry is booked.

| Coverage status | Premium may be booked |
|---|---|
| Scheduled | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Removed | Yes |
| Terminated | Yes |
| Expired | No |

## Occasions for premium entries

| Coverage event | Premium entry |
|---|---|
| Coverage added | Premium charged |
| Coverage removed at the named insured's request | Unearned premium returned |
| Coverage terminated because the owner term was cancelled | Unearned premium returned |
| Coverage restored because the owner term was reinstated | Premium charged |

The coverage's net premium is the premium charged less the premium returned.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

1. Full-term towing premium $48.00, owner term of 182 days, charge covering 120 days: $48.00 multiplied by 120 is 5,760.00; divided by 182 that is 31.6483...; rounded to the nearest cent the charge is **$31.65**.
2. Full-term towing premium $10.01, owner term of 182 days, entry covering 91 days: $10.01 multiplied by 91 and divided by 182 is 5.005; with the half cent rounded up the entry is **$5.01**.
